avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May reduce linezolid efficacy through CYP3A4 induction; also has independent serotonergic activity increasing serotonin syndrome risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative mood support if necessary

avoid_supplements.name: 5-HTP
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Linezolid has weak MAO inhibitory properties; combined serotonergic activity significantly increases serotonin syndrome risk
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; discontinue 5-HTP before linezolid initiation and wait 2 weeks after discontinuation

avoid_supplements.name: L-Tryptophan
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Precursor to serotonin; linezolid's MAO inhibition impairs tryptophan metabolism, substantially elevating serotonin syndrome risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid during linezolid therapy; counsel patient to avoid tryptophan-rich supplements

avoid_supplements.name: SAM-e
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Serotonergic activity combined with linezolid's weak MAO inhibition increases serotonin syndrome risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; discuss alternative supplements with healthcare provider

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: Theoretical stimulant effects may be additive with linezolid's potential for hypertension and serotonergic activity
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood pressure and mood symptoms; use with caution and at lowest effective dose

caution_supplements.name: Magnesium supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: No direct interaction, but high-dose supplementation may affect GI absorption; linezolid is well-absorbed orally but GI side effects are common
caution_supplements.action: Separate dosing by 2-4 hours if supplementing; monitor for GI tolerance

avoid_foods.name: Aged cheeses (cheddar, blue, Swiss, Parmesan)
avoid_foods.mechanism: High tyramine content; linezolid's MAO inhibitory activity impairs tyramine metabolism, risking hypertensive crisis
avoid_foods.action: Strictly avoid aged cheeses during linezolid therapy; counsel patient on tyramine-restricted diet

avoid_foods.name: Cured/processed meats (pepperoni, salami, prosciutto, bacon)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Significant tyramine levels; linezolid-induced MAO inhibition increases hypertensive and cardiovascular risk
avoid_foods.action: Avoid during treatment; provide written tyramine-restriction guidance

avoid_foods.name: Fermented soy products (soy sauce, miso, tempeh)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Contains substantial tyramine from fermentation; linezolid's weak MAO inhibition poses hypertensive risk
avoid_foods.action: Avoid soy sauce, miso, and fermented soy; fresh tofu in moderation acceptable

avoid_foods.name: Fermented vegetables (sauerkraut, kimchi)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Moderate tyramine content from fermentation process; may elevate blood pressure when combined with linezolid's MAO activity
avoid_foods.action: Minimize intake during therapy; advise patient to monitor for headache or hypertension symptoms

avoid_foods.name: Broad beans/fava beans
avoid_foods.mechanism: Contains tyramine and dopamine; linezolid's weak MAO inhibition reduces their metabolism, increasing hypertensive risk
avoid_foods.action: Limit consumption; avoid large quantities during linezolid therapy

caution_foods.name: Soy sauce (regular/non-fermented alternatives acceptable)
caution_foods.mechanism: Modern low-tyramine versions pose minimal risk; fermented versions should be avoided per avoid_foods
caution_foods.action: Use low-sodium, non-fermented soy sauce alternatives if desired; limit quantity

caution_foods.name: Caffeine-containing beverages
caution_foods.mechanism: Theoretical additive stimulant effect; linezolid may rarely increase blood pressure
caution_foods.action: Moderate intake (limit to <200mg/day); monitor for palpitations or hypertension

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: May potentiate CNS effects and increase risk of hypertension; linezolid can cause dizziness and headache
caution_foods.action: Limit to moderate consumption; avoid heavy drinking during therapy

monitoring_notes: Linezolid's weak MAO inhibitory properties necessitate strict tyramine avoidance to prevent hypertensive crisis; counsel all patients on comprehensive tyramine restriction before initiating therapy. Monitor for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, confusion, rapid heart rate, muscle rigidity) especially if patient takes concurrent serotonergic agents; baseline and periodic blood pressure monitoring recommended.
